trace_conclusion: The two direct production callers pass harness.session() straight to SessionValues::load. JSONL parse_entry_mutation strips kind/lane and deserializes the entry; the CustomEntry decoder copies customType as a String. Replay chain_onto_lane_leaf mutates only parent_id, and SessionState stores the entry unchanged. Session::query_entries delegates the unchanged custom_type query (only limit may be overridden), and SessionState::matches_entry_query tests exact equality. No custom_type rewrite is present in this bounded path.
